name: carbone
description: Design Carbone templates in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML or Markdown and generate documents from JSON data without leaving your editor, from a single PDF to large batches. One universal templating language with loops, conditions, charts and barcodes, a high-performance engine built for production, and 100+ formats. Bundles the Carbone skill and the hosted Carbone MCP server.
suggestedPrompts: Use Carbone to design an invoice template and generate a sample PDF.
Use Carbone to list my templates and the data each one expects.
What kinds of documents can Carbone generate for me?
